guidance: Dog benefit from regular brushing, occassional bathing, and routine nail trimming. Grooming frequency depends on dog's coat type and activity level.
Short-haired cats typically benefit from weekly brushing, while long-haired cats may need daily grooming. Nails should be trimmed every 2-3 weeks.
A dog's feeding routine depends on its age, size, breed, and activity level. Many adult dogs are commonly fed about two meals per day.

confidence.guidance: Cats benefit from a balanced diet, regular meal times, and constant access to fresh water.
Dogs generally benefit from regular walks for exercise and mental stimulation. The ideal length and frequency depend on age, breed, health, and energy level.
Cats usually need a minimal amount of daily exercise to get them up and running. Around 30 minutes minimum and 10-15 minutes of playing with any toys
Always consult a vet or a professional for particular types of medicine to give pets. Never give without consultation
Dogs and cats should always have access to clean, fresh water. A general guideline is about one ounce of water per pound of body weight each day, although individual needs vary.
Dogs benefit from a quiet, comfortable sleeping area and a consistent routine. Adult dogs commonly sleep about 12–14 hours a day, while puppies and senior dogs may sleep 18–20 hours.
Cats should have some play time before they dose off for sleep. They should have around 12-16 hours of sleep while kittens shall sleep 20
Playtime for doggies include variety of activities like fetch, tug-of-war, and interactive toys. Ensure safe environment and supervise playtime. Around 30-60 minutes of playtime daily is recommended.
Playtime for cats include moving toys away from reach so that they will run over and catch it. Should be around 10-15 minutes per day
Vet visits are necesssry for both the cat and dog to ensure they are healthy and up to date on vaccinations. Schedule regular checkups and follow vet recommendations.
